split: Feature-identical groups including missingness assigned jointly using GroupShuffleSplit: 50% groups train, remaining groups equally validation/test; seed then seed+1; raw group allocation shared by all arms. No stratification or split reselection.

arms_definition.all_rows: Keep all original rows, including conflicting labels
arms_definition.deduplicate_same_label: Keep first row per feature vector and label; retain opposite-label representatives
arms_definition.exclude_conflicts: Remove all conflicting-label feature groups, then keep first feature row

parameters: Same features, train-only preprocessing, LR/RF settings, F2, B<=2, 5 seconds, d=ceil(.05n) and ceil(.10n) as source_benchmarks/protocol.json
interpretation: Paired group assignments, but training/validation size, composition, d and scores vary; no causal estimate of cleaning alone and no population validity. Feature groups are not patient IDs.
